G_LANGUAGE_COUNTRY.scope: Any supported language may target any supported country; general countries/currencies, Shopping-tab marker; FR metropole restriction.

G_SHOPIFY_SYNC.scope: Shopify app-specific country/language table and sync behavior; not the global Merchant language-country ceiling.

G_TARGET_COUNTRY.scope: General supported country list including explicit beta El Salvador; actual account Countries selector is decision-critical.

G_BETA.scope: Beta countries accept supported languages, but access may be restricted to selected retailers. Current article contains no explicit country list.

G_FREE.scope: Free-listing opt-in, eligibility, shipping; no guarantee of display.

G_SHOPIFY_FREE.scope: App free-listing country table and opt-in; not a global ceiling for beta countries.

G_MULTI.scope: Multiple target countries per offer, source reuse, per-language sources, currency/landing/shipping consistency.

G_PRIMARY_SUPPLEMENTAL.scope: Only primary sources add products; supplements match existing ID/language/label and enrich existing products.

G_FILE.scope: Files/scheduled fetch provide a manual-primary-source path; direct uploads require continuing refresh.

G_QUOTA.scope: Default standalone quota150000 per scope; organic scope and actual account/MCA constraints; default200 sources. Actual account quota unknown.

G_ADS_POLICY.scope: Explicit Russia pause covers ads to Russia and advertisers based in Russia; do not infer a blanket free-listing ban.

G_API_PRODUCT.scope: Product identity is contentLanguage~feedLabel~offerId and returned primary dataSource.

G_API_SOURCE.scope: API primary can accept any language and label; sources do not namespace products; defaults may enable all account destinations.

G_API_MIGRATE.scope: Avoid accidental product ownership transfer across primary sources; retain source attribution and offer identity.

G_CSS.scope: Existing CSS selection matters to European free listing eligibility; no CSS transfer recommended.

interpretation.sixty_three_pairs: Exact intersection of published Shopify locale codes and Shopify app documentation. Not a global Merchant maximum.
interpretation.unlisted: Unknown from reviewed general/beta table. Do not infer approved, unsupported everywhere, or silently target as parent territory.
interpretation.merchant_account_evidence: No country selectable, source received, offer approved, claim freshness, quota or free-listing destination state was read in this lane.
interpretation.shopping_tab: A separate surface flag; absence of a Shopping tab is not absence of all free product listings.
interpretation.all_4945_variants: Reconcile every variant to a stable identity and truthful current availability; not all are assumed in_stock or eligible.
interpretation.display: Submission or eligibility cannot guarantee impressions, traffic or profit.
interpretation.exact_join_gap: A missing exact app pair is a documented coverage gap candidate, not proof the app cannot map an alias or that a new source is already necessary. Verify actual source languages and ownership first.

feasibility.reuse_first: Inspect/reuse existing app-owned sources and country sets without altering ownership. Additional languages need missing primary inputs; supplements cannot create absent language identities.
feasibility.manual_file: A translated primary file per necessary language/pricing partition with scheduled refresh is technically supported; create only genuinely uncovered cells after dedup/ownership review.
feasibility.supplemental: Only enrich matched existing product IDs with exact language and feed-label mapping.
feasibility.api_future: A Merchant API primary can hold multiple languages/labels, reducing source-container count; no integration readiness or execution authority inferred here.
feasibility.app_manual_toggle: Switching the Shopify app to manual stops its automatic product sync. Do not toggle as a shortcut to fill language gaps.
feasibility.identity_key: Merchant API v1: contentLanguage~feedLabel~offerId; source name is separate ownership, not a namespace.
feasibility.country_reuse: Do not create country copies when the same language/currency/price/landing and shipping model can lawfully serve multiple supported countries.
feasibility.destination_control: Expansion is FREE_LISTINGS only; explicitly inspect data-source and item included/excluded destinations, existing linked campaign consumption, and CSS. New sources can inherit account destinations.

arithmetic.warning: These are coverage arithmetic, not measured offer count, approval count or actual quota use. Stable multi-country offers can share country coverage; currency/price partitions or app labels can multiply identities.

minimum_native_readback_sequence: Owner-ready exact Merchant513 account and claimed storefront domain, account standing, retained Shopify connection/source IDs.
Business info Countries available/selected countries; free-listing account, source, and offer destinations/exclusions; existing CSS and linked-consumer state.
All primary/supplemental source language, feed label, owner, latest update, processed counts, errors, source rules, offer ID-to-source map and current organic quota/headroom.
Shipping/returns country-cost-currency and evidenced delivery settings; stable localized variant landing-to-checkout correspondence.
Fresh processed FREE_LISTINGS country status for each expected offer/language/country; reconcile missing/rejected/excluded and genuinely out-of-stock items separately.
